complexity.policy: Signals require review and a recorded disposition; they are not automatic violations.
complexity.regression_policy: Do not increase any baseline count or add a new Radon E/F symbol without a symbol-level rationale; refresh the snapshot only during a reviewed maintenance pass.

accepted_signal_groups.rationale: The majority of signals are explicit option matrices, validation branches, and deployment state transitions. Current behavior is protected by CLI/TUI parity, source-permutation, manifest, and lifecycle suites; split only at cohesive seams during feature work.

accepted_signal_groups.scope: Backend media, research, RAG, and memory lifecycle handlers
accepted_signal_groups.rationale: Signals are concentrated in ownership-aware asynchronous state machines. Current controls cover admission, idempotency, recovery, cancellation, leases, and terminal-state mapping; refactors must preserve those state-machine contracts.

The 109.3% increase is explained by the manifest-per-service migration, generated three-surface service diagrams, provider implementations, and their regression suites. Generated artifacts are drift-gated; future growth remains subject to the 20% release-over-release signal.

Behavior is protected by the custom-node resolver, consumer-manifest collision, MPS provisioner, manifest-generation, and doctor suites.
